name: Mida Yuuichi

At the start of the game, he hears a woman's voice after he finishes masturbating, but he can't find where the voice is coming from. She gives Yuuichi a power due to his insane amount of lust. When he starts hearing voices like he did with the mysterious woman's voice, by yelling out "Clockup" when he gets a boner from masturbating, he can make the unseen seeable.
